tools.name: callHierarchy
tools.description: Incoming or outgoing calls at position. External deps included by default. Set externals=false to exclude.

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the callHierarchy tool.
Returns incoming or outgoing calls for a function at a given position.
inputSchema.title: CallHierarchyParams

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the findIdentifier tool.
Returns all occurrences of a specific identifier name within a file.
inputSchema.title: FindIdentifierParams

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the findReferences tool.
Returns all references to a symbol at a given position.
inputSchema.title: FindReferencesParams

tools.name: goToDefinition
tools.description: Definition of symbol at position. Returns signature, source code (first ~100 lines), and related symbols (max 5).

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the goToDefinition tool.
Returns the definition location of a symbol at a given position.
inputSchema.title: GoToDefinitionParams

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the getDiagnostics tool.
Returns diagnostics (errors, warnings) for a file or the entire workspace.
inputSchema.title: GetDiagnosticsParams

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the goToImplementation tool.
Returns implementations of an interface or abstract method.
inputSchema.title: GoToImplementationParams

tools.name: documentSymbol
tools.description: Symbols defined in a file (top-level only by default; set include_children for nesting)

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the documentSymbol tool.
Returns symbols defined in a file (top-level only by default; set include_children for nesting).
inputSchema.title: DocumentSymbolParams

tools.name: semanticSearch
tools.description: Search code semantically using natural language queries. Returns ranked code chunks based on embedding similarity.

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the semanticSearch tool.
Performs semantic code search using natural language queries over indexed code chunks.
inputSchema.title: SemanticSearchParams

tools.name: findReferencedSymbols
tools.description: Symbols referenced by definition. External deps included by default. Set externals=false to exclude.

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the findReferencedSymbols tool.
Returns all symbols referenced by a definition at a given position.
inputSchema.title: FindReferencedSymbolsParams

tools.name: initialInstructions
tools.description: Read this on startup to know how to use LSP-MCP properly.

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the workspaceSymbol tool.
Searches for symbols across the entire workspace by name.
inputSchema.title: WorkspaceSymbolParams

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover info at position. Use include_definition to also get definition location. Use 'requests' for batch mode with array of {path, line, character}

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the hover tool.
Returns hover information (documentation, type info) for a symbol at a given position.
Supports both single-position and batch mode via requests parameter.

requests.description: JSON string containing array of hover requests for batch mode.

inputSchema.title: HoverParams
